description: Student's t survival function 1 - F(x; df) = F(-x; df) (location 0, scale 1)

tolerance.reason: 1 - F(x) = F(-x) and the grid is symmetric, so the reasoning of t_cdf applies mirrored: the condition number |x f(x) / (1 - F(x))| reaches 901 at a normal result (df = 1e8, x = 30), so up to 1.0e-13 is unavoidable; 2e-13 allows about 2x that. SciPy's worst error here is 1.03e-13 (df = 1e4, x = 30), except that it returns 0.5 at x = +-1e-10 for df = 1 and 0 at x = 1e300 for df <= 1
